---
title: "Stage 4 — bind the analysis"
---

Saying which statistical method operates on the derived value, and what plays each role in
it.

## What this is

An Analysis Concept is the aggregated, non-subject-level result: a comparison, a summary, a
model. Binding it means mapping the chain's outputs onto the method's roles — response, fixed
effect, covariate, strata.

## What you do

Choose the analysis transformation and bind each role.

## What you should see

A complete specification of the analysis, ready to be put into a study-level document.

## What to look out for

**You author from templates, not from methods, and there are far fewer templates.** The
method library is much larger than the set of things the builder can actually author — in the
pinned version, 39 of 60 methods have no template at all.

So "the method exists" does not mean "the analysis can be authored". Check for a
transformation before planning an endpoint around a method, or you will reach this stage and
find nothing to select.
